[[Yesteryear]] |map = {{Map|name=Lumbridge|width=300|height=400|zoom=1|x=3188|y=3220}} |type = settlement |leagueRegion = Misthalin }} [[File:Lumbridge logo.png|left|40px]] {{Relative location |location = Lumbridge |north = Varrock |east = Al Kharid |south = Lumbridge Swamp |west = Draynor Village }} '''Lumbridge''' is a large town where players begin their ''[[Old School RuneScape]]'' journey. New players are sent here from [[Tutorial Island]] to further learn the game from various [[tutor]]s across the town. Lumbridge gets its name from the bridge that crosses the [[River Lum]]. After a player's [[death]], Lumbridge is the player's default [[Spawning|respawn]] point, although players can change their respawn location to other locations. The main point of interest of Lumbridge is the [[Lumbridge Castle]], where players can start several [[quests]] and access its [[Lumbridge Castle bank|bank]] at the top floor. ==Transportation== Several transport options bring players into or close to Lumbridge, listed here with their arrival destination. From closest to farthest: *{{Plink|Lumbridge Home Teleport}} — castle courtyard, once every 30 minutes. No [[Magic]] requirement or [[rune]] cost. *{{Plink|Lumbridge Teleport}} — castle courtyard. *{{Plink|Death|pic=Skull (status) icon|txt=Dying}} — castle courtyard (only if a respawn is set there). Players should bank items before doing this. **The {{Plink|ring of returning}} and the{{Plink|Respawn Teleport}} spell work the same way. * {{plink|Canoe|pic=Paddle}} — Lumbridge canoe station. *{{Plink|Amulet of glory}} — nearby [[Al Kharid]] or [[Draynor Village]]. *{{Plink|Gnome glider|pic=Gnome goggles}} — Al Kharid. *{{Plink|Fairy ring|pic=Fairy ring (Construction) icon|txt=Fairy code}} {{Fairycode|DIP}} — [[Abyssal Nexus]] via the [[Appendage]] or {{Fairycode|DIS}} — [[Wizard's Tower]]. **Taking any fairy ring to [[Zanaris]] then leaving also leads to the [[Lumbridge shed]]. *{{Plink|Cowbell amulet}} — inside the [[Lumbridge cow field|cow field]]. === Shortcuts === * [[Broken raft]] - A grapple spot between Al Kharid and Lumbridge requiring {{SCP|Agility|8|link=yes}}, or {{SCP|Agility|48|link=no}} without a grapple. * [[Fence (Varrock)|Fence]] - A fence requiring {{SCP|Agility|13|link=yes}}. * [[Stepping stone (Lumbridge Swamp)|Stepping stone]] - A stepping stone providing quick access to the Kalphite lair, requiring {{SCP|Agility|66|link=yes}}. The [[Gate (Al Kharid)|Al Kharid gate]], found east of [[Lozar's house]], connects Lumbridge to its neighbour city [[Al Kharid]]. Until the player has completed [[Prince Ali Rescue]] [[quest]], it will cost 10 [[coins]] to pass either way through this gate to Al Kharid, though it can be avoided with a long detour north of the [[Groats' farm]]. [[Group Ironman Mode|Group Ironmen]] can find the portal to [[the Node]] on the north wall of the castle. ==History== During the [[Third Age]], the caves underneath what would become Lumbridge become home to [[Dorgeshuun|a lost tribe of goblins]], who no longer wished to fight in the God Wars. In the year 1937 of the [[Fourth Age]], long after the God Wars ended, a town was settled on the River Lum by migrating human nomads. A bridge was made over the [[River Lum]], connecting the areas separated by the river, which is why the settlement was named Lumbridge.{{CiteText|text=Display case (Varrock Museum, number 6)|quote=4th Age - yr 1937 Settlers established a town on the River Lum. Across the river they build a bridge and hence the town became called Lumbridge. This heralded more human settlements springing up early in the next age, where humans began to move into the desert, establishing Al Kharid, and towns on both Karamja and Entrana.}} [[Duke Polonius|Polonius]] was the first Duke of Lumbridge. Polonius was given the land by the then King of Varrock, [[King Claudius]], and built [[Lumbridge Castle]] in the place of the original wooden fortress,{{CitePostbag|issue=4|letter=Letter 3|author=Duke Horacio}} with the [[Lumbridge Church]] being built shortly after.{{CiteNPC|npc=Father Aereck|quote=The castle is even older than this church, and so it's terrible that it would be damaged, even if it's only the cellar.|loc=The Lost Tribe|notes=|name=}}{{CiteNPC|npc=Father Aereck|quote=[Nice place you've got here.] It is, isn't it? It was built over 230 years ago.|loc=|notes=|name=}} Today, the current Duke of Lumbridge is [[Duke Horacio]], who is a direct descendant of Polonius. On the eastern side of the River Lum, many [[Goblin (race)|goblins]] have take up residence, conducting raids in the area. [[Lozar]], a wizard who owned the [[Lozar's house|house]] located on the eastern side of the river, was recently killed and looted by goblin raiders.{{CiteNPC|npc=Guildmaster|quote=A few weeks ago, I'd have told you to speak to Lozar herself, in her house across the river from Lumbridge. Unfortunately, goblin raiders killed her and stole everything.|loc=Dragon Slayer I|notes=|name=}} [[File:Goblin house.png|thumb|Lozar's house, many players' first point of combat.]] == Locations == Lumbridge has a number of interesting locations, including training locations, character houses, combat areas, and [[list of farms|farms]]. === Buildings and stores === {| class="wikitable" !Building !Description |- |[[Bob's Brilliant Axes]] |Owned by [[Bob]], this store buys and sells a limited range of [[axe]]s, which include [[pickaxe]]s; [[Bronze axe|bronze]], [[Iron axe|iron]] and [[steel axe]]s; and [[Iron battleaxe|iron]], [[Steel battleaxe|steel]], and [[mithril battleaxe]]s. He also repairs [[Barrows equipment]], [[axe]]s, and [[pickaxe]]s for a price. The store is advertised on [[flyer]]s dropped by many [[monsters]]. A building that is likely Bob's house is attached on the northern side. |- |[[Cordero|Cordero's]] former house |A small home with a [[range]]. A [[woman]] can be found inside. |- |[[Father Urnhey]]'s house |The house of a hermit who provides players with the [[ghostspeak amulet]]. |- |[[Lozar's house]] |A building located across the river overrun with level 2 and 5 goblins and an [[iron dagger]] [[Spawning|spawn]]. This area is a very popular area for new players to start training. Between the house and the river there are a [[Canoe|canoe station]] and a few [[fishing spots]]. |- |[[H.A.M. Hideout|H.A.M. house]] |The ruins of a house that contain the entrance to the H.A.M. hidehout. |- |[[Lumbridge Castle]] |A large castle featuring [[Duke Horacio]] and his advisor [[Sigmund]]. The [[spinning wheel]], used in [[Crafting]], is also located upstairs, along with [[Cadmus]]. If you have started the [[Recipe for Disaster]] [[Quests|quest]], there is a [[Culinaromancer's Chest|bank]] in the [[Cook (Lumbridge)|Cook]]'s basement, as well as a wide variety of cooking ingredients and cooking implements to buy. There is a [[Lumbridge Castle bank|bank]] on the top floor of the castle. The basement contains the entrance to the [[Dorgesh-Kaan mine]] and the [[Culinaromancer's Chest]], which becomes accessible after the completion of [[Recipe for Disaster]]. |- |[[Lumbridge church]] |[[Father Aereck]] watches over his 230+ year old church of [[Saradomin]] here. There is also an altar to recharge [[Prayer]] points. South of the Saradomin Church is the [[Lumbridge Graveyard|Lumbridge graveyard]], featuring [[Nigel]] and [[Count Check]]. Next to the southern exit, a mausoleum house containing a coffin plays an important role in [[The Restless Ghost]]. |- |[[Lumbridge General Store]] |A store which sells some items useful for new players. It also buys [[items]] from players for a small amount of [[coins]]. |- |[[The Sheared Ram]] |A bar featuring [[Veos]], a treasure hunter from [[Great Kourend]]. Players who are new to [[clue scroll]]s may speak to [[Arthur the Clue Hunter]] to learn more about them. If players have [[Adventure Paths]], [[Adventurer Jon]] is found outside the pub on the southern wall. |- |Smiths' building |A building containing [[Feoras]] the Smithing apprentice, a [[furnace]], and a [[rusted anvil]]. It's not recommended for training, since this anvil can only smith [[bronze equipment]], and no [[bank]] or mine is nearby. |- |[[Zanaris shed]] |An unassuming shed in the swamp that leads to the magical city of [[Zanaris]] after completing the [[Lost City]] [[quest]]. |} [[File:Lumbridge Swamp Caves.png|thumb|The deadly swamp caves.]] === Skill training spots === * Players looking to train [[Mining]] can find 5 [[Copper rocks|copper]] and [[tin rocks]] at the [[East Lumbridge Swamp mine]], and 7 [[Coal rocks|coal]], 5 [[Mithril rocks|mithril]], and 2 [[adamantite rocks]] at the [[West Lumbridge Swamp mine]] nearby. * Many spots allow for [[Fishing]] training, including the River Lum fishing spots (for catching, [[trout]], [[pike]], and [[salmon]], requiring levels 20, 25, and 30 respectively), and the swamp fishing spots (for catching [[shrimp]], [[sardines]], [[herring]], and [[anchovies]], requiring levels 1, 5, 10, and 15 respectively). The latter features [[Finlay]], the Fishing tutor. * For [[Woodcutting]], many [[tree]]s fill the town. Players with level 15 Woodcutting can cut [[oak tree]]s west of the [[Lumbridge Castle]], and players with level 30 can cut the [[willow tree]]s located north-west of it. Players with level 60 Woodcutting can chop the two [[yew tree]]s found either west of the castle or in the graveyard. === Farms and fields === Lumbridge features many farms and fields: * [[Fred's farm]], a large [[list of farms|farm]] where players can shear [[sheep]] to obtain [[wool]] which may be spun at the castle. [[Onion]]s can be collected from the farmer's garden. Also, there is a log standing on the ground outside of [[Fred the Farmer]]'s house from which a [[bronze axe]] may be taken. There are also many [[chicken]]s here that new players can kill. ** The [[Lumbridge cow field (north)]] is a large cow field north of Fred's farm. * [[Groats' farm]], a massive farm featuring cows, chickens, and farming patches. The chicken coop is commonly used for players to train early [[Prayer]] levels, since all chickens drop bones and are very easy to kill. ** The [[Lumbridge cow field]] is a part of the Groats' farm featuring many level 2 and 5 [[cow]]s and [[Cow calf|calves]], which are useful for low level players who wish to train their first [[combat level]]s. These cows also have a 100% [[drop rate]] of [[raw beef]], [[cowhide]], and [[bones]]. A [[dairy cow]] is also available for milking, being part of [[Cook's Assistant]] [[quest]]. * The [[Mill Lane Mill]] is a [[windmill]] connected to several large fields and pens. * A [[tree patch]] and a [[hops patch]] can be found behind the [[Lumbridge Castle]] and north of the [[Lumbridge water mill|Groats' farm water wheel]], respectively. * There is also the [[Lumbridge pond]], a small pond inhabited by [[ducks]]. [[File:Lumbridge Graveyard.png|thumb|The graveyard and back of the church.]] === Lumbridge Swamp === {{Main|Lumbridge Swamp}} The large [[Lumbridge Swamp]] is filled with [[rats]] on the surface, and even more monsters in [[Lumbridge Swamp Caves|the caves below]]. The caves feature low-level [[Slayer]] monsters, which player must bring a [[light source]] to enter and fight against. East of the the swamp is the traveller's camp, a camp set up by a [[Warrior (Lost City)|warrior]], an [[Archer (Lost City)|archer]], a [[Wizard (Lost City)|wizard]], and a [[Monk (Lost City)|monk]] who seek the city of Zanaris. The Sheared Ram old house interior.png|The interior of the house that existed before being changed into The Sheared Ram. ==Trivia== *The name 'Lumbridge' is based on the real life city of {{Wp|Cambridge}}, England, where the Gower brothers grew up and where [[Jagex]] has its headquarters. The cities' name schemes are similar: Lumbridge is built over the river Lum while Cambridge is built over the river Cam. *Upon players completing the quest [[Garden of Tranquillity]], the statue of [[King Roald]] outside of the Lumbridge castle courtyard becomes an empty plinth and the statue itself is moved to the garden east of the Varrock palace. *The fourth [[god letter]] contains a response by [[Saradomin]] writing about the early days of ''RuneScape''. He says Lumbridge used to host traditional Sunday afternoon craft fairs that were 'a bit of a let down' as a result of there being no [[Crafting]] skill at the time.{{CiteGodLetter|issue=4|letter=Letter 2}} *According to another god letter, Lumbridge has a football team called the [[Lumbridge Eagles]]. ==References== {{reflist}} {{Lumbridge}} [[Category:Misthalin]]
